title: 第8章 来袭第9章 战蛊族大军
content_zh:
半小时后，“人还真是多啊，半小时，不见人少过。”
女帝与邪帝背靠背，长时间的能量输出，女帝能量快要耗尽了。
“来了，暗之国禁忌术——魔神！”邪帝手中出现一股混沌之力，周边的天地灵气涌入其中，蓄能很快，凝聚完毕向天空中发射出去，这股力量在空中爆炸，像万千雨水一般，注入邪帝与女帝体内，二人能量瞬间回满。
“天照剑，天谕！”女帝手中出现一把剑，此剑剑柄上有对羽翼，宽大的剑身散发着柔和的光辉，女帝轻轻一舞，随着一招天谕从空中斩下，漫天华光，一路上的蛊人凐灭于光辉之下。
“复仇毁灭光线！”邪帝的复仇火焰周围出现八只死灵眼，射出光线，蛊人轰杀殆尽。死灵眼由幽冥火化为，经常被邪帝当作眼睛使用。
“邪帝大哥，该走了。”女帝见蛊人一时之间不敢再上前来。
邪帝显然还没有杀过瘾，“刚打完魔神，就撤啦？这不浪费么！”
“又不是我让你用的。撤撤撤，开始撤退！”邪帝转头一看，女帝早已飞离好远。
“啊？不等我？行行行，幽冥火！”邪帝走之前向蛊人群中放了一把火，潇洒飞去。
......
“我们回来了。”邪帝与女帝很快回到了屋内。
“嗯，如何？没受伤吧？”神君看着二人。
“别看了，你妹没事，有点妹控了哥。”
“闭嘴！”神君圣君二人声音同时响起。
“哦。”邪帝刚准备转身走出去，这里看来是待不下去，思索了一下，转过身，“不对啊，你叫什么？”
“关你屁事。”圣君眼睛看向一边。
“不是，啊？不关......”邪帝瞪大眼睛。
“好了。说一下战况如何。我们这边倒是听到蛮多动静的。”冰帝面带微笑出声阻止了还要争吵的几人，她很喜欢看他们假吵。
“都比较菜，修为很低。幽冥火有效，杀了蛊人不知道多少个，反正今晚蛊人大乱了。不过他们人是真多，杀半小时，愣是没觉得人少，不过也没有出现统领那样的人。”
“那还可以，看来是我们期望太高了。”冰帝思索了一下。

“报告！邪帝大哥还用了一发魔神，不小心展现了一下帝王极刀意，小小的施展了一下神级武技。”女帝举起手打起了小报告。
“让你说话了吗你就说?”邪帝敲了下女帝的脑壳。
“啊！”响起了一声充满了穿透性的尖叫声。
“......”说实话几人都挺无语的。
“发现了吗？”短暂的沉默之后，神君突然来了句莫名其妙的话。
“嗯。有俩个天神境后期在看我们干架。”邪帝也表情严肃。
“啊？就那俩啊？我还以为是什么蛊人统领，原来不是蛊人啊？”女帝显然也发现了那俩人。
“从我来圣天一族这里的第三天他们就出现了。不过好像是在观察我的实力把，并没有动手什么的，也不知道是哪个势力的，胆子有点大啊。
虽然身上有点隐匿的道具，但不够看呐。他俩死了吗？”神君道出了情况。
“没有，已经离开了这片大陆了，我派了一只死灵眼盯着。
算了，管他呢，小小的展露一点手段给他们看，兵来将挡水来土掩。
蓝星女神也说了，马上会开启新时代，很期待呢。”邪帝摇了摇头，不想继续这个话题。
蓝星女神便是蓝星大陆之神。
“嗯，反正你打不过了有神君，以后的事以后再说。先都去休息吧。今晚蛊族估计会大乱，延缓进攻攻势，给圣天一族喘息的时间。”
“好的老大。”
“炎君我们去看月亮吧，听说满月大陆的月亮每晚都是圆的。”
“好啊。”女帝挽着炎君的胳膊，俩人亲密的走了出去。
......
此刻的蛊族大殿里。
“今晚来袭击的人是谁！”

“一个是刀修，领悟了起码天级刀意。一个是用光明力量的女子。我们伤亡了五分之一的人数。”
“什么？五分之一？就两个人？可恶啊。”
content_en:
Half an hour later, "There are so many people. For half an hour, there are not many people missing."
The Empress and the Evil Emperor were back to back, and after a long period of energy output, the Empress' energy was almost exhausted.
"Here comes the forbidden art of the Kingdom of Darkness - the Demon God!" A force of chaos appeared in the hands of the Evil Emperor, and the spiritual energy of the surrounding heaven and earth poured into it. It accumulated energy very quickly, and after condensation, it was launched into the sky. This force exploded in the air, like thousands of rains, and poured into the bodies of the Evil Emperor and the Empress. Their energy was instantly restored.
"Amaterasu Sword, Heavenly Mandate!" A sword appeared in the empress's hand. There were a pair of wings on the hilt of the sword. The broad sword body exuded a soft brilliance. The empress danced lightly, and with a move of the Heavenly Mandate, she cut down the Heavenly Mandate from the sky. The sky was filled with light, and all the Gu people along the way were wiped out by the light.
"Revenge of destruction light!" Eight undead eyes appeared around the evil emperor's revenge flame, shooting out light, killing all the Gu people. The eyes of the undead are formed from the underworld fire and are often used as eyes by the Evil Emperor.
"Brother Evil Emperor, it's time to go." Seeing the Gu man, the empress did not dare to come forward again.
The Evil Emperor obviously hasn't had enough of killing him yet. "We just finished defeating the Demon God and are you withdrawing? Isn't this a waste!"
"I didn't ask you to use it. Get out, get out, start retreating!" The Evil Emperor turned around and saw that the Empress had already flown far away.
"Ah? Wait for me? Go, go, go, Netherworld Fire!" Before the Evil Emperor left, he set a fire into the Gu crowd and flew away gracefully.
...
"We are back." The Evil Emperor and the Empress quickly returned to the house.
"Well, how is it? You're not hurt, are you?" Shenjun looked at the two of them.
"Don't look at it. Your sister is fine. She's a bit controlling."
"Shut up!" The voices of the Divine Lord and the Holy Lord sounded at the same time.
"Oh." The Evil Emperor was about to turn around and walk out. He seemed like he couldn't stay here any longer. He thought for a moment and turned around, "That's not right. What's your name?"
"None of your business." Shengjun looked away.
"No, huh? It doesn't matter..." The Evil Emperor's eyes widened.
"Okay. Let's talk about how the battle is going. We heard a lot of noise here." Hyokui smiled and stopped a few people who were still arguing. She liked watching them pretend to argue.
"They are all relatively useless, and their cultivation level is very low. Netherworld Fire is effective, and I don't know how many Gu people were killed. Anyway, there was a big chaos tonight. But there are so many of them. After killing for half an hour, I didn't feel that there were fewer people, but there was no one like a leader."
"That's okay. It seems that our expectations are too high." The Ice Emperor thought for a moment.
"Report! The evil emperor brother also used a demonic shot, accidentally showing the emperor's extreme sword intent, and performing a small god-level martial arts." The empress raised her hand and made a small report.
"You just said it if I asked you to speak?" The Evil Emperor knocked the Empress on the head.
"Ah!" A penetrating scream sounded.
"..." To be honest, several people were quite speechless.
"Did you find it?" After a short silence, the Lord Shen suddenly said something incomprehensible.
"Yeah. There are two late-stage gods in the realm watching us fight." The evil emperor also looked serious.
"Ah? Just those two people? I thought they were some kind of Gu leader, but it turned out they weren't Gu people?" The empress apparently also discovered those two people.
"They appeared on the third day after I came to the Shengtian Clan. But they seemed to be observing my strength and didn't do anything. I don't know which force they belong to. They are a bit brave.
Although there are some hidden props on him, they are not enough to look at. Are they dead? "The Lord Shen told the situation.
"No, he has already left this continent, and I sent an undead eye to keep an eye on him.
Forget it, never mind him, show them a little trick, and the soldiers will cover up the water and the earth.
Blue Star Goddess also said that a new era will begin soon, and I am looking forward to it. "The Evil Emperor shook his head, not wanting to continue this topic.
Blue Star Goddess is the God of Blue Star Continent.
"Well, you can't fight anyway.After you have a god, we will talk about the next thing later. Let's all go rest first. The Gu clan is expected to be in chaos tonight, delaying the offensive to give the Shengtian clan some time to breathe. "
“Okay boss. "
“Jun Yan, let’s go see the moon. I heard that the moon in the Full Moon Continent is full every night. "
"OK. "The empress took Yan Jun's arm, and the two of them walked out intimately.
...
In the Gu Clan's main hall at this moment.
“Who is coming to attack tonight! "
"One is a sword cultivator who has understood at least the heaven-level sword intention. One is a woman with the power of light. We lost a fifth of our men killed or wounded. "
"What? One fifth? Just two people? Damn it. "
